Subject: Dedicated GPU architecture deep-dive request — Clearwave POC

Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off a POC for inference at Clearwave and would like a technical architecture deep-dive focused on dedicated GPU capacity: pool sizing, autoscale behavior under burst, and isolation strategies. Our infra lead (Aaron Park) and a product manager (Maya Singh) will join. We expect ~45–60 minutes for the session.

Constraints to flag:
- Our initial workload spikes are bursty (30–90s traces) — need guidance on slot sizing and burst capacity.
- Must validate isolation patterns to avoid cross-tenant KV cache leakage.
- We have SOC 2 and DPA requirements; would like ~15m at the end for security Qs.

Can you run this as a live demo + architecture walk? Available windows next 2 weeks: mornings ET (9–11am) or late afternoons ET (4–6pm). Attached a CSV with sample utilization traces and a short list of questions.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Lee
